title.zh: 商品与服务税（保释与个人保证）条例 2019
title.en: Goods and Services Tax (Bail and Personal Bond) Regulations 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 10 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Goods and Services Tax (Bail and Personal Bond) Regulations 2019.
2. In these Regulations, “released person” means any person who is released on bail or on the person’s personal bond.

heading.en: When person may be released on bail or personal bond

text.en:
3.—(1) When any person is arrested by the Comptroller, a specially authorised officer or a specially authorised customs officer (called in these Regulations an arresting officer) and the person is prepared at any time to give bail in accordance with regulation 4, the person must be released on bail by a Magistrate or the arresting officer.
(2) Instead of taking bail from the person, the Magistrate or arresting officer may release the person if the person signs a personal bond without any surety in accordance with regulation 4.

5. Every surety of a person released on bail must —
(a)ensure that the released person surrenders to custody, makes himself or herself available for investigations or attends court on the day and at the time and place appointed for the released person to do so;
(b)keep in daily communication with the released person, and lodge a police report within 24 hours after losing contact with the released person; and
(c)ensure that the released person is within Singapore unless the released person has been permitted by the Magistrate or arresting officer mentioned in regulation 4(4)(e) to leave Singapore.
6. The amount of every bond executed under regulation 4 must be fixed with due regard to the circumstances of the case as being sufficient to secure the attendance of the released person.

7.—(1) An arrested person must be released by a Magistrate or an arresting officer as soon as the bond has been executed —
(a)in the case where the person is released on bail — by the person and every surety required by the Magistrate or arresting officer to execute the bond; or
(b)in the case where the person is released on personal bond — by the person.
(2) Nothing in these Regulations requires the release of any person liable to be arrested for some matter other than that in respect of which the bond was executed.

8.—(1) Section 107 of the Criminal Procedure Code 2010 applies in a case where a released person bound by a personal bond executed under regulation 4(2), fails to surrender to custody, make himself or herself available for investigations, or attend court on the day and at the time and place appointed for him or her to do so.
(2) Section 107A of the Criminal Procedure Code 2010 applies in a case where a released person for whose appearance a bond was executed by the released person and one or more sureties under regulation 4(1), fails to surrender to custody, make himself or herself available for investigations, or attend court on the day and at the time and place appointed for him or her to do so.
9. Section 108 of the Criminal Procedure Code 2010 applies to any order made under regulation 8 by a District Court or Magistrate’s Court.

heading.en: Power to direct Magistrate’s Court to exercise powers under regulation 8

text.en: 10. A District Court may direct any Magistrate’s Court to exercise the court’s powers under regulation 8 in respect of a bond to appear before the District Court in accordance with section 109 of the Criminal Procedure Code 2010.
